ac_results.ac: `src/parse.mjs` exports `parseEnv(text)` returning `{pairs: {key,value,line}[], problems: {line,message}[]}`; `node --test test/parse.test.mjs` exits 0 (covers: REQ-16)
`KEY=value` lines become pairs with 1-based `line`, key and value trimmed (covers: REQ-10)
ac_results.evidence: test 'KEY=value with line numbers and trimming'

ac_results.ac: lines whose first non-space char is `#` are ignored (covers: REQ-11)
blank and whitespace-only lines are ignored (covers: REQ-12)
`S='a b'` and `D="c d"` yield values `a b` and `c d`, with no escape processing (covers: REQ-14)
a line with no `=`, an invalid key or an unterminated quote yields a problem carrying its 1-based line number, and the line is skipped (covers: REQ-15)
`src/parse.mjs` has no `import` of a rules module; a test asserts this by reading the file (covers: REQ-21)
ac_results.evidence: test 'no rules import' reads the source

ac_results.ac: `parseEnv("")` and a comments-only text return `{pairs: [], problems: []}` (covers: REQ-6)
`parseEnv` never throws for any string, tested over `""`, `"="`, a lone quote and non-UTF8-ish text (covers: REQ-7)

assumptions: a quoted value must end with the same quote char as it starts with; otherwise it is an unterminated-quote problem
the export prefix is the literal 'export ' followed by the key; whitespace around key and '=' is trimmed
a lone '=' line yields an invalid-key problem (empty key)
